finding: The Tier-3 ingestion throughput step-change is a measurement-environment artifact: the laptop was disconnected from AC power mid-run. It is NOT a corpus-size / index-scale degradation and NOT thermal throttling.
root_cause: AC power disconnected at 2026-09-06T11:10:29Z (16:40:29 IST), which falls between ledger row 47 (last AC scene, finished 2026-09-06T11:06:25Z, 203.6 tiles/s) and row 48 (first battery scene, finished 2026-09-06T11:15:32Z, 93.4 tiles/s). On DC/battery the RTX 4060 Laptop GPU power/clock budget and the CPU package power limit are both cut, ~halving BOTH the CPU-side tile preprocessing and the GPU-side embedding forward pass - which is why mean_embed_latency_ms and build_time_s doubled together and stayed doubled for the rest of the run (the machine remained on battery until 2026-09-06T13:04:07Z, after the run ended at ~12:35Z).

evidence.windows_event_log: System log, Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Power event ID 105 'Power source change' at 2026-09-06 16:40:27 IST (= 11:10:27 UTC).
windows_battery_report: 2026-09-06 11:06:45  Active  AC       60%   (Tier-3 run in progress on AC)
2026-09-06 16:40:29  Active  Battery  100%  (unplugged at full charge = 11:10:29 UTC)
2026-09-06 18:34:07  Active  AC       32%   (reconnected, long after run ended)
evidence.index_size_independence: Within the AC segment the index grew 6,965 -> 75,843 vectors (~11x) while big-scene throughput stayed 210.5 tiles/s mean (193.9-218.8, +/-6%) - flat. The drop to 123.7 tiles/s mean coincides with the power-source change, not with any index-size threshold. Ingestion cost in this architecture is per-tile (preprocess + forward pass + FAISS append + SQLite insert) and does not scale with existing corpus size; this was the expectation and it held on AC.
evidence.thermal_ruled_out: A thermal throttle would relax during the multi-minute network-fetch gaps between scenes (GPU idle, short duty cycle). The degradation instead persisted uniformly across all 17 post-switch scenes and every inter-scene gap - the signature of a sustained power-envelope change, not heat.

impact_on_reported_numbers: All Tier-3 ingestion-throughput numbers measured after 2026-09-06T11:10:29Z (ledger rows 48-64, i.e. the 'ingestion throughput 144.1 tiles/s / -29%' and 'pure embedding 293.4 tiles/s / -22%' cells in the Tier-3 measurement table) are on battery power and UNDERSTATE the machine's actual capability. The AC-power rate (rows 0-47, and Phase 7a / Tier 1 / Tier 2, all on AC) is ~205-210 tiles/s and is the number that reflects sustained capability. No re-run is required to establish this; the OS power-state log is authoritative.
hardware_note_for_PS2.3: Hardware: RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (8 GB), driver 592.82, 16 logical CPUs, Windows 11. Power scheme 'Balanced'. AC vs battery materially changes sustained GPU/CPU throughput on this class of machine - benchmarks intended to characterise capability must be run on AC and the power source recorded.
